subject: general
question: **Direction: Choose the incorrectly spelt word. **
solution:
The correct answer is **"Conssume."**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** 

__
 
• The incorrectly spelt word is **"Conssume."**
 
• The correct spelling of the word is** "Consume."**
 
• It means to use something such as fuel, energy or time. (इंधन, ऊर्जा, समय आदि का प्रयोग करना; उपयोग करना)
 
 
• **Example:** *Our high living standards cause our current population to **consume**__ 25 percent of the world's oil.*
 
 
 
• The correct answer is Option 1.**
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__** 

 
• Motive: **a reason for doing something, often something bad. (प्रयोजन, इरादा (प्रायः कुत्सित))
 
• **Horror: **a feeling of great fear or shock. (बहुत डर या सदमा; दहशत, आतंक)
 
• **Showing: **an act of showing a film, etc. (फ़िल्‍म आदि का प्रदर्शन)
